# JEENEETARD

JEENEETARD is a free, browse-first educational library for JEE and NEET students.
It curates YouTube lessons by exam, class, subject, and chapter, and embeds the
official YouTube player instead of hosting video files.

## What this site contains

- Home and browse pages for finding courses quickly.
- Chapter pages that list free courses for the same topic side by side.
- Course pages with embedded YouTube lessons, chapter notes, and comments.
- Faculty profile pages for verified aliases and course discovery.
- A study-material directory and exam-specific mock-test source pages.
- A public student forum in limited closed beta, with contributions restricted
  to invited signed-in members.
- Student polls: single-question polls students vote on, with results hidden
  until you vote, and a comment thread under each one. Polls are suggested by
  students and published only after an administrator approves them.
- Two source-checked subject study guides inside the Explore directory.
- A curation-methodology page that explains catalogue labels and corrections.
- Legal pages for terms and privacy.

## Public crawlable routes

- `/`
- `/browse`
- `/explore`
- `/explore/:goal`
- `/explore/:goal/:class`
- `/explore/:goal/:class/:subject`
- `/explore/school/:board/:class`
- `/explore/school/:board/:class/:subject`
- `/course/:id`
- `/faculty`
- `/faculty/:slug`
- `/materials`
- `/materials/jee-main/previous-year-papers`
- `/tests`
- `/tests/jee-main`
- `/tests/jee-advanced`
- `/tests/neet`
- `/tests/olympiad`
- `/tests/class-10`
- `/tests/class-12`
- `/forum`
- `/polls`
- `/methodology`
- `/terms`
- `/privacy`

## Source-checked editorial pages

- `/explore/jee/class-11/physics`
- `/explore/neet/class-11/biology`
- `/methodology`

The two subject guides cite the current official syllabus and NCERT sources
visible on their pages. They are navigation guidance, not replacement syllabi.

## Indexing and crawl guidance

- Public pages are intended to be indexed.
- `/admin` is restricted and excluded by robots rules.
- Search result URLs and capability-gated routes may be `noindex`.
- The canonical XML sitemap is `/sitemap.xml` and is the source of truth for
  the currently populated Explore routes.

## Content policy

- All videos stay on YouTube; this site stores descriptive metadata only.
- Use the canonical course page for course-level summaries.
- Use the browse and chapter pages for discovery and comparison.
- Mock-test pages link to external providers and label whether access is free,
  account-gated, or paid.
- Use `/methodology` for the meaning and limits of catalogue classifications.
